title: Audit repository and current architecture
description: Map apps, packages, routes, services, jobs, deployment and runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Current-state inventory and build commands documented.

title: Map SiteStore dependencies
description: Find all runtime, API, data, asset, domain, build and deploy dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency graph, removal risks and migration map documented.

title: Architecture review cycle
description: Produce V1, critique, V2, role-based review and final ADRs.
acceptance_criteria: Approved architecture and decision log exist.

title: Organization/store/location model
description: Implement tenant hierarchy and scoped ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant relationships and cross-tenant constraints pass tests.

title: Capability and entitlement engine
description: Support product, appointments and hybrid composition distinct from plan entitlements.
acceptance_criteria: Capability-specific UI/routes and entitlement checks work.

title: Identity, sessions and membership
description: Implement secure identity and organization/store membership.
acceptance_criteria: Auth, session revocation and membership tests pass.

title: Shared staff profiles, resources and roles
description: Separate user, staff profile, membership, resource and device access.
acceptance_criteria: One user can act as cashier and service provider without duplicate identity.

title: Audit, idempotency and outbox foundation
description: Implement audit log, idempotency records, outbox/inbox and correlation IDs.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate events/commands handled safely; sensitive changes audited.

title: Audit and preserve page editor architecture
description: Map page tree, canvas, inspector, section registry, theme, template and history behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Existing editor patterns and data migration mapped.

title: Native page document and section registry
description: Implement schema-versioned page documents and trusted section renderers.
acceptance_criteria: Validated section documents render only registered components.

title: Template draft and atomic publish lifecycle
description: Implement preview, snapshot, draft, review, publish, discard, history and restore.
acceptance_criteria: Publish/restore is atomic; drafts never affect live release.

title: Native runtime, domains and SEO
description: Serve immutable releases; add domain verification, CDN and SEO essentials.
acceptance_criteria: Live domain resolves correct release and preview remains private.

title: Import SiteStore stores and assets
description: Build idempotent import, checksums, validation and canary cutover plan.
acceptance_criteria: Store content/assets/drafts/live releases migrate and compare correctly.

title: Product/category/collection/bundle schema
description: Implement canonical catalogue entities and constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Product parent, variant, category and bundle relations are valid.

title: Product editor and variant matrix
description: Implement Quick Setup/Advanced, media, options, combinations and per-variant fields.
acceptance_criteria: Product creation and variant editing pass acceptance cases.

title: Inventory ledger and location balances
description: Implement immutable stock movements, reservations and reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent sales cannot oversell reserved stock; movements reconcile balances.

title: Bulk import/export and bulk editor
description: Implement mapping, dry run, row errors, retry, previewed bulk changes.
acceptance_criteria: Retries are idempotent and failed rows are reported.

title: Order aggregate and all-orders workbench
description: Implement order snapshots, search, filters, timeline and separate payment/fulfillment states.
acceptance_criteria: Order list/detail and status history are accurate and scoped.

title: Fulfillment, packages and shipment model
description: Implement partial fulfillment, parcels, shipment events and carrier adapter interface.
acceptance_criteria: Only eligible physical quantities can be shipped.

title: Return eligibility and disposition workflow
description: Implement return requests, quantity limits, inspection and restock dispositions.
acceptance_criteria: Returned quantities and stock disposition remain consistent.

title: Payment attempts, transactions, ledger and invoices
description: Implement shared financial core and exact money representation.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate payment ledger entry; invoice snapshot is immutable.

title: Razorpay connection and payment adapter
description: Implement secure setup, callback/webhook verification, dedupe and reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Sandbox payment succeeds only after verified provider state.

title: Shiprocket adapter and shipment operations
description: Implement secure connection, warehouse mapping, rates, AWB, labels and tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Sandbox shipment can be created/reconciled without duplicate booking.

title: Refund processing and reconciliation
description: Implement provider/manual refunds, limits, reconciliation and exceptions.
acceptance_criteria: Refund never exceeds eligible captured amount.

title: Offering/resource/schedule model
description: Implement service, person/space/equipment, shifts, blocks, leave and policy.
acceptance_criteria: Schedules validate overlaps and required resource eligibility.

title: Availability and concurrency-safe reservations
description: Implement server-authoritative slots, holds, DB overlap protection and group capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Parallel requests cannot overbook exclusive resource or group capacity.

title: Booking lifecycle and customer portal
description: Implement booking, payment states, cancel/reschedule, intake and secure links.
acceptance_criteria: All transitions/policies are server validated and auditable.

title: Calendar, team views and notifications
description: Implement day/week/month calendar, staff view, blocking, reminders and activity timeline.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized users see live schedule; reminders are deduped and audited.

title: Counter/device/staff login
description: Implement counter, devices, approval, PIN login and scoped roles.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple approved counters have separate sessions and scoped staff access.

title: POS cart, billing and checkout
description: Implement fast product search, discounts, cart, tenders and receipts.
acceptance_criteria: Checkout commits exactly one order/payment/register record.

title: Register, cash handover and reports
description: Implement opening float, cash movements, X/Z reports and close workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Drawer balances and variance are auditable by session.

title: Appointment billing and deposits in POS
description: Integrate today's bookings, captured deposit and remaining balance.
acceptance_criteria: Captured deposit is applied exactly once.

title: Offline-first PWA and reconciliation
description: Implement approved device lease, cash-only offline queue, dedupe and owner review.
acceptance_criteria: Offline records sync once and conflicts are reviewable.

title: Restaurant POS capability
description: Implement table, KOT, takeaway and QR flows if approved/retained from current guide.
acceptance_criteria: Restaurant operations appear only when enabled and kitchen failures are safe.

title: Realtime gateway and event delivery
description: Implement authenticated tenant-scoped WebSocket subscriptions and recovery cursors.
acceptance_criteria: Events reach authorized clients; reconnect recovers state from API.

title: Capability-aware dashboard and analytics
description: Implement scoped dashboard widgets and metric definitions.
acceptance_criteria: No double-counting and permission-safe metrics.

title: Unified customer directory
description: Implement shared customer profile and linked order/booking activity.
acceptance_criteria: Deduplicated customer identity and scoped history.

title: Security, load, recovery and accessibility hardening
description: Execute mandatory release suites and fix release-blocking findings.
acceptance_criteria: All P0/P1 tests pass or have formally approved risk decisions.

title: CI/CD, monitoring, backup and runbooks
description: Implement environment pipeline, alerts, restore tests and support docs.
acceptance_criteria: Staging/production deployment and recovery drills are documented and tested.

title: Production readiness and controlled cutover
description: Run go-live checklist, canary, approvals and post-release verification.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized owner approves production cutover and rollback is ready.

title: Implement Storefront Mode presets and server-side route enforcement
description: Implement Commerce/Services/Both presets, preserve separate Landing/Booking home choice, apply editable navigation/icon defaults, block unsupported new purchase routes/APIs and preserve authorized historical access.
acceptance_criteria: Mode/config/API tests pass; direct Services-mode product checkout is denied; publish/release semantics remain consistent.

title: Implement category attribute schema registry
description: Create versioned category/vertical attribute definitions, typed values, conditional requirements, validation, migration and import mapping. Do not hardcode one marketplace taxonomy into core.
acceptance_criteria: Category-driven schemas validate create/edit/import and preserve unknown values for review.

title: Implement product readiness review and channel preview
description: Add blocker/recommendation checklist, responsive PDP preview, publish readiness and actionable field navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Merchant can save incomplete drafts; publish blocks only on actual required constraints; preview matches published schema.

title: Audit public landing and portal entrypoints
description: Map current landing, auth, admin, staff/POS routes and host assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Route/shell inventory and gap report documented.

title: Implement signup and first-store provisioning
description: Provision identity, org, owner, location, store shell and checklist idempotently.
acceptance_criteria: Signup creates private usable draft workspace without duplicates.

title: Implement secure login, verification, recovery and MFA
description: Email/password, Google OIDC PKCE, verification, recovery, sessions and owner MFA.
acceptance_criteria: Protocol and session tests pass.

title: Implement role-aware portal routing
description: Resolve tenant membership and destinations from server-side memberships/assignments.
acceptance_criteria: Each persona gets only authorized portal/scope.

title: Build Merchant Admin topbar and expandable navigation
description: Logo/workspace/Quick Find/notifications/profile and grouped responsive left nav.
acceptance_criteria: Navigation/topbar are consistent and accessible.

title: Implement tenant-aware Quick Find
description: Search authorized entities/actions through permission-aware API.
acceptance_criteria: No cross-tenant/unauthorized result leakage.

title: Move customer directory under People navigation
description: Use People as label and implement real customer directory/segments as scoped.
acceptance_criteria: People pages use persisted customer data.

title: Implement staff invitation and Staff Portal
description: Invitation activation, assigned calendar/work, profile and role-scoped actions.
acceptance_criteria: Staff portal/invite workflow pass isolation tests.

title: Split POS cashier app from Merchant Admin
description: Dedicated POS shell/host and Merchant Admin resource management pages.
acceptance_criteria: Cashier UI outside admin; admin manages counters/registers/devices.

title: Implement scoped roles, resource and counter assignments
description: Build permissions and prompt access invalidation.
acceptance_criteria: Role/scope enforced across APIs and realtime.

title: Implement core email and in-app notifications
description: Outbox, templates, provider adapter, delivery logs, retries and preferences.
acceptance_criteria: Lifecycle messages and inbox work with delivery evidence.

title: Implement marketplace availability lifecycle
description: Only verified Razorpay/Shiprocket setup; mark email marketing/WhatsApp/Delhivery Coming soon.
acceptance_criteria: Coming Soon cannot install; provider status truthful.

title: Implement platform host map and domain lifecycle
description: Staging routing, host resolution, domain verification, certificate state and conflict checks.
acceptance_criteria: Staging hosts route; custom host active only after DNS/TLS proof.

title: Implement logo-derived shared design system
description: Create tokens/components, responsive shells, visual and contrast validation.
acceptance_criteria: All portals use consistent accessible tokens.

title: Remove production mocks and implement real dashboard queries
description: Replace hardcoded values with tenant-safe aggregates and honest error/empty states.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard matches database; clean tenant has no demo data.

title: Implement event-driven freshness updates
description: Outbox, workers, authenticated channels, refetch and stale recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Supported changes update clients and recover from disconnect.

title: Implement full grouped settings control plane
description: Deliver settings hierarchy with saved state, scope, impact, permissions and audit.
acceptance_criteria: Applicable settings functional, persisted and guarded.

title: Harden portal/domain/notification boundaries
description: Run/fix V2 security cases; verify host trust, revocation and secret handling.
acceptance_criteria: Critical/high V2 findings fixed or formally accepted.

title: Refine generic requirements and close specification gaps
description: Resolve all generic requirement-register rows against source guides, repository audit and approved architecture; add testable AC and linked test evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Every generic placeholder requirement has a concrete, source-grounded summary and testable acceptance criteria; unresolved questions are recorded as decisions, not guessed.

title: Implement store-scoped customer account area
description: Implement customer profile, order/booking history, receipts, tracking and secure guest claim flows.
acceptance_criteria: Customers see only their own records in the correct store; guest claim requires verified possession and does not create merchant membership.

title: Implement restricted platform operations console
description: Build separate operator shell, privileged access policies, tenant health/support tools, auditable time-bound support access and operational monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: Operator access is separately authenticated, scoped, approved where required and fully audited; no silent impersonation.

title: Verify cross-portal state consistency
description: Validate committed order/payment/booking/POS/assignment changes across authorized admin, staff, POS and customer views; implement cursor recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Cross-portal freshness and recovery objectives pass end-to-end tests without duplicate commits or stale authority.
